title: Improving Tail-Augmented Speculative Drafting with Hidden State Mixing and Gradient Detach
abstract: arXiv:2611.34092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) modules and EAGLE-style drafters support efficient speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states. Their autoregressive use, however, introduces a training-inference mismatch: training supplies sequences of hidden states from the backbone or a single MTP step, whereas inference attends to a target-model prefix followed by a growing tail of recurrently generated MTP states. EAGLE-3's training-time test (TTT) explicitly simulates this behavior during training, at the cost of additional memory and specialized attention masks. We introduce two training-only methods for improving autoregressive drafting. translated_title: 通过隐状态混合与梯度分离改进尾部增强的推测草稿生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34092v1 公告类型：cross。多 token 预测（MTP）模块和 EAGLE 风格的草稿模型通过复用目标模型的隐状态来支持高效的推测解码。然而，它们的自回归使用方式带来了训练与推理之间的不匹配：训练时提供的隐状态序列来自骨干模型或单一的 MTP 步骤，而推理时则面向目标模型的前缀，并附加一段由递归生成的 MTP 状态构成的、不断增长的尾部。EAGLE-3 的训练时测试（TTT）方法在训练期间显式模拟了这一行为，但代价是额外的内存开销和专门的注意力掩码。我们提出两种仅作用于训练阶段的方法来改进自回归草稿生成：隐状态混合在对应同一预测目标的骨干隐状态和 MTP 隐状态之间进行采样，使草稿模型接触到来自不同 MTP 步骤的状态组合，而无需显式模拟推理过程；隐状态梯度分离则是一种正则化方法，它随机地……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出两种仅用于训练阶段的方法——隐状态混合（HSM）和隐状态梯度分离（HSGD），在不显式模拟推理、不增加额外内存和专用注意力掩码的情况下，缓解推测解码草稿模型的训练-推理不匹配，从而改进自回归草稿生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two training-only techniques—Hidden State Mixing (HSM) and Hidden State Gradient Detach (HSGD)—that mitigate the training-inference mismatch in autoregressive speculative drafting without explicitly simulating inference, extra memory, or specialized attention masks.
